summary: The fix adds a warning with worker event-loop activity and idle time when a timed SQLite request takes at least one second to reach the worker.
reasoning: The incident delayed live messages, and this patch adds telemetry to help distinguish a busy worker loop from a delayed wakeup. The local history shows that #171082 exposed request phase timings and #189705 added thread IDs for wait attribution. The new warning leaves delivery behavior unchanged.
